say:4:1321816001:1.text: The plants here—they're unnatural. Twisted, as if warped by some unseen force.

say:5:1321816002:1.text: I can't pinpoint what kind of magic it is, but I'm certain it isn't something the undead are capable of...

choice_prompt:6:1321816002.text: I can't pinpoint what kind of magic it is, but I'm certain it isn't something the undead are capable of...

say:7:1321816003:1.text: The Frost Furie, you say? Hasn't she been sealed already?
say:7:1321816003:1.source_cn: 冰之恶魔？！但她已经被你们封印了！

say:8:1321816005:0.text: They could be the Frost Furie's minions. Remember those Hypogean minions we encountered before?
say:8:1321816005:0.source_cn: 我觉得这有可能是冰之恶魔的眷属，我们之前不也曾碰到过那...

say:9:1321816006:0.text: Do you mean... they are her underlings?
say:9:1321816006:0.source_cn: 恶魔眷属……它们是冰之恶魔的属下？

say:10:1321816007:0.text: Exactly. They may lack her power, but their loyalty is unwavering.
say:10:1321816007:0.source_cn: 可以这么说，这些恶魔眷属虽然没有冰之恶魔那么强大的力量...

say:11:1321816008:0.source_cn: 恶魔的魔法造成的伤口确实很难被普通药剂治愈，之前我居然...

say:12:1321816009:0.text: Don't blame yourself, Hammie. We saw the man surrounded by undead—it was natural to assume they were responsible. But if the Hypogean minions struck him down, then why were the undead there at all?
say:12:1321816009:0.source_cn: 这不怪你，漫漫女士。毕竟我们亲眼看到了那些活死人围着那...

say:13:1321816010:1.text: Who knows? They couldn't have been fighting the Hypogean minions, right?
say:13:1321816010:1.source_cn: 谁知道呢，总不能是活死人在和恶魔眷属打斗吧！

choice_prompt:14:1321816010.text: Who knows? They couldn't have been fighting the Hypogean minions, right?

say:16:1321816013:0.source_cn: 真没想到，但或许这才是真相……

say:18:1321816015:0.source_cn: 等等，有人在喊你的名字。这声音……听起来似乎是瓦丽卡女士……
